1.label: very_easy
1.summary: One broad ring; follow a slowly changing 2D path and its visible OPEN/PINCH hand changes.
1.natural_language: Keep the whole dark tip inside every moving ring with the shown hand. Fill all fading traces together. full.description: Pick up the painted brass handle with the intended left/right mouse button and drag it to a new aim. The grip and aim persist on release.

simplified.description: Click any point in a chamber to aim its brass nib; change its grip with the matching OPEN/PINCH buttons. No auto-aim or altered physics.
